_meta.coverage_keys: every row carries values_dispatched / distinct_bytes / encodable_range / start / width / coverage_pct / thin / under_covered. THIN = values_dispatched < encodable_range. UNDER-COVERED = distinct_bytes < values_dispatched, which is the only signal that a sweep dispatched values it never actually encoded (DEF-0166-1).
_meta.foreign_fields: `dst` on every descriptor is EXP-0168's verdict (coordinator directive 2026-08-30). Swept here as this experiment's detection instrument; NO verdict emitted.
_meta.gate: cross-run agreement >= 99% AND min(movedA,movedB) >= 2.0 x disagreements, over >= 2 common values; the (arm,carrier) liveness ladder must have passed first
_meta.pairing: per field, the two runs with the most distinct attributed values (EXP-0164 cross_run's own rule), so an arm captured in a separate later pair is not diluted by the earlier one
_meta.question: does the ORIGINAL promotion recorded in validation.json reproduce in this fresh capture?

calibration.async_note: device_load on G17P is ASYNCHRONOUS and this harness issues no wait/scoreboard barrier. The number of landed registers grows monotonically with filler instructions inserted between the loads and their use: F=0,2,4,8 -> 0 of 8 landed; F=16 -> 2; F=32 -> 5; F=64 -> 8; F=128 -> 8. See raw/pilot03/calibprobe2.jsonl.
calibration.evidence: device_load idx_off unit = 1 WORD, HW-VALIDATED on G17P: with sufficient filler between issue and use, r_k loaded at idx_off k reads ramp word k for every k in 0..13 (E1 F=64 and F=128: 8 of 8; E2: 14 of 14 on five consecutive repeats). Note this is a DIFFERENT unit from device_store, whose idx_off unit is 4 words (EXP-0090/EXP-0119, isa_helpers.STORE_STRIDE_WORDS).
calibration.measured_by: raw/pilot03 (calibprobe2.py) E1 F=64 and F=128, and raw/pilot03 E2 x5
calibration.note: device_load idx_off unit in WORDS, solved from a ramp image in which every word is self-identifying. Frozen here BEFORE the gated runs; the C2_load semantic oracle depends on it.
calibration.supersedes: harness/smoke.py S3, which could not solve the unit: its solver read all-zero registers because its hand-built program placed the dump immediately after the loads, with no slack. Retained unedited in raw/pilot01/.

bf_alu.opsel.original_range: 0x1c add vs 0x1d mul (2 of 256), spliced and observed

bf_alu.tail.original_range: framing only (round-trips; no value semantics established)

device_store.base_slot.original_range: 0..255 census on the load path; store path probed at slots 0,3,31,32,63,127,128,255 - slot 128 writes are DISCARDED (mirror is load-only)

device_store.idx_off.original_range: boundary points 0x1FF, 0x200, 0x3FF, 0x400, 0x7FF at idx 1023/1024 - all landed outside the 8 KiB target, which is exactly what the 16-byte store unit predicts

device_store.index_reg.original_range: 0..95 fully round-trip correct; 96,97,100,111,120,127 uniformly FAULT; 112 is genuinely NONDETERMINISTIC (fault or silent-all-zero across byte-identical splices)

falu2.ctrl.original_range: all 7 bits individually at {0,1}: bits0/1 are the 0x09-group instruction-LENGTH selector (and therefore corrupt when flipped in place), bits2/3/4 inert, bits5/6 silent corruptors

falu2.mod_hi.original_range: bit44 at {0,1} (silent corrupt-to-zero, crossed against reg field 3 and 67); bits45-47 at all 8 values (no observable effect)

falu2.opflags.original_range: each of bits 19..23 individually at {0,1}: 19=release srcA, 20=release srcB, 21=destination publication, 22/23=silent corrupt-to-zero

falu2.opsel.original_range: 3-bit field swept via a 256-value byte+2 sweep: 4=fadd and 5=fmul validated on all 8 don't-care combinations; 0b111 -> contained GPU hang

falu2.srcA_class.original_range: byte+5 bit0, within the dense 0..7 sweep of the former 3-bit `mod_lo`

falu2.srcA_reg.original_range: 0..63 dense (15-point sweep with poison-register controls); 64..112 alias r(R mod 64); 126,127 -> CMDBUF_ERROR

falu2.srcA_reg_top.original_range: {0,1} crossed against reg-field values {3,67} and against opflags bit19 in {0,1}; reproduced in falu2i, falu2_ext (both slots), falu3_srcmod12 (both slots) and under 15-deep register pressure

falu2.srcB_class.original_range: byte+5 bits[2:1], within the dense 0..7 sweep of the former 3-bit `mod_lo`

falu2.srcB_reg_top.original_range: {0,1} crossed against reg-field values {3,67} and against opflags bit20 in {0,1}

falu2_uni.uni_mode.original_range: 0,1 (toggling makes the operand read the GPR, i.e. 0)

falu2i.ctrl_lo.original_range: framing only (round-trips; no value semantics established)

falu2i.imm_exp.original_range: 8..15 (the valid minifloat domain, values +-{1/32..30} incl. both extremes); exp<8 is NOT an immediate - it is the falu2_uni uniform-source overload

falu2i.imm_mant.original_range: 0..7 exhaustive across the 16 spliced constants and the generated boundary-weighted immediate pool

falu2i.opflags.original_range: bit20 at {0,1} (source release, load-bearing); bits21-23 NOT tested in this form

falu2i.opsel.original_range: 4 (fadd) and 5 (fmul) of 8 encodable, both constructed and executed

falu2i.srcA_reg.original_range: 0..63 dense; value 67 reads r3 (mod-64 alias); 64..112 alias; 126,127 fault

get_sr.dst_hi.original_range: the register EXTENSION half of the same lockstep 0..127 boundary sweep

get_sr.sr_sel.original_range: 0x00..0xFF EXHAUSTIVE (256 values x 2 runs, zero faults, zero hangs): 0x80-0xFF reaches the special-register file (16 named, ~106 aliasing 0x9c/0x99/0x9a/0x82/0x85, 4 unclassified constants, 2 period-4 structured); 0x00-0x7F is a distinct 'selector materialized as an immediate' region, not an SR read

half_alu.opsel.original_range: 0x1c hadd vs 0x1d hmul (byte+2 low 3 bits), splice-observed

half_alu.srcA.original_range: 0x02, 0x04, 0x06, 0x08 swept: only 0x02 reads a; every other value makes srcA read 0 so the result is b alone

half_alu.srcB.original_range: 0x00, 0x02, 0x04, 0x06, 0x08 swept: 0x00/0x04 read b, 0x02/0x06 null the op, 0x08 gives a+const

half_alu.src_modifier.original_range: byte+5 swept with distinct per-lane inputs: bits6:7 (0xc0) are a required operand-valid base (clearing them yields 0), bit3 (0x08) = srcA-negate (0xc8 -> -a+b), bit0 suppresses srcB, bits1/2 suppress srcA

half_alu_ext8.b5.original_range: bits3/4 null in this instance; largely inert

half_alu_ext8.op_valid_marker.original_range: every byte+7 value WITHOUT bit7 set nulls the op (result 0) - a required op-valid marker

half_alu_ext8.opsel.original_range: gains 6 = hfma (byte+2 = 0x1e); half fma compiles to this 8-byte form

half_alu_ext8.rsv6.original_range: 0x00..0xc0 swept, every value kept the result - fully INERT/reserved in the add+saturate instance

half_alu_ext8.saturate.original_range: byte+7 0x82 clamps saturate(9) to 1; 0x80 (bit1 clear) passes 9 unclamped; 0xc0 also passes

half_alu_ext8.srcA.original_range: byte+3 0x02 works, 0x04/0x06 break; byte+6 swept 0x00..0xc0 all inert

half_alu_ext8.srcB_desc.original_range: 0x01 required in the add+saturate instance; carries the fma srcA-negate (byte+7 0xc0 -> 0xc8)

half_alu_fma12.ext.original_range: framing only (round-trips; no value semantics established)

ibitcount.op_enable.original_range: byte+4 swept 0x00..0x0a: only bit1 matters - 0x02/0x03/0x06/0x07/0x0a compute, 0x00/0x01/0x04/0x05/0x08/0x09 give 0

ibitcount.src.original_range: 16 values sampled (boundaries + powers of two + interior)

ibitcount.srcdesc.original_range: byte+6 swept: 0x00 degenerates the op to identity (raw input returned, popcount NOT applied); bit6 (0x40) must be set for the GPR source to be read (0x3c/0x9c -> 0; 0x5c/0x4e/0x58/0x5e/0x7c/0xdc read normally); EXP-0129 additionally swept the genuinely free bits (22 cases): bit4 is a real BIDIRECTIONAL release control, bit0 and bit3 also break the stored result, all other bits inert

reg_move_c0.src_reg.original_range: producer-independent and register-PAIR-quantized at every one of 4 tested pairs; src_reg is ALWAYS 0 in all 1545 corpus instances

reg_move_c1.src_reg.original_range: 4 src_reg values (0,2,4,8) x 3 buffer-count variants: content was uniformly 0 in all 12 cases, both runs

reg_move_c9.src_reg.original_range: 4 tested register pairs, both runs: X and X^1 read identical content, producer-independent
